title: The lantern over the Harbour of Nowhere
quote: a green lantern rose out of the water and hung there for a minute it made no sound and then it went straight up

title: A vault under Mount Fictus

title: The lanterns are a mirror

title: The flare that hung still
quote: a flare does not hang still for a whole minute
